description: B1 feature victim cap on two peers, part 2: an ARMCOM at the wrecks' centre for THIS peer (owner 0 is the local player), camera on it. Apply on the joiner after b1-victim-features-wrecks is on every peer; select it and self-destruct it (ctrl+d). A non-host peer does not damage a feature itself: 0x4244B0 sends a 0x0F per call to the host, which applies each. Set MultiCommanderDeath to 0 for the launch, or the commander's death wipes the joiner's army.
